style: who is speaking to whom, and what has just happened

candidates.angle: Seeing only divided states is rajasic

en.intro: Krishna has just described clear vision that sees unity. Now he turns to the restless mind. Listen for how he names the divided view.
en.notice: Notice the word 'tu', but. Krishna places this divided seeing against the unity he described in the previous verse, marking it as a lower state of understanding.
en.next: Krishna then describes the lowest kind of understanding, the dark, that clings to a single body as the whole truth.
en.meaning: But know that knowledge as rajasic by which one sees many different beings as separate and distinct in all beings.

hi.meaning: परन्तु जो ज्ञान अर्थात् जिस ज्ञानके द्वारा मनुष्य सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें अलगअलग अनेक भावोंको अलगअलग रूपसे जानता है, उस ज्ञानको तुम राजस समझो ॥
hi.notice: ध्यान दीजिए 'तु' पर, यानी 'परन्तु' पर। कृष्ण इस विभाजित देखने को पिछले श्लोक की एकता के विपरीत रखते हैं, और इसे निम्नतर ज्ञान बताते हैं।
hi.next: कृष्ण फिर सबसे निम्न ज्ञान, तामस का वर्णन करते हैं, जो एक शरीर को ही सम्पूर्ण सत्य मान लेता है।
